verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's own docs claim revenue attribution beyond opens and clicks. Analytics AI 'explains which campaigns and automations are actually moving revenue,' grounded in real store sales. The Magento integration's e-commerce tracking measures campaign ROI, and the homepage cites conversion-funnel insights. However, the evidence is marketing-level, revenue tracking appears to depend on an e-commerce integration, and signup attribution to specific emails or flows is not shown. Missing for 10: documented per-email/per-flow revenue reports and attribution model, signup/conversion attribution, detail on setup requirements beyond the Magento integration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
